boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Stockton University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations with publicly posted evening availability in Galloway and nearby Atlantic County.

cards.title: Denny’s on East White Horse Pike
cards.subtitle: 242 E White Horse Pike, Galloway
cards.notes: Use the location page before heading out; it lists near-continuous service and supports dine-in, pickup, and delivery.
cards.short_summary: A Galloway diner with service extending to midnight or later.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s lists this Galloway location’s hours as ending at 11:58 PM, 12:59 AM, or operating through midnight depending on the day.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists daily hours ending at 11:58 PM, 12:59 AM, or midnight; check the page for the applicable day.

cards.title: Castillo Pizzería Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 80 W Jimmie Leeds Rd, Galloway
cards.notes: Plan a pickup order for the posted 11 PM close, and confirm availability directly on the restaurant’s ordering page.
cards.short_summary: A Galloway pizza restaurant posted open until 11 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Castillo Pizzería Restaurant’s official ordering page lists its Galloway address and hours of 11 AM–11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists 11:00 AM–11:00 PM; verify before travel because hours can change.

cards.title: Hoon King Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 219 E Collins Rd, Galloway
cards.notes: Choose pickup or delivery and use the restaurant’s posted schedule; Friday and Saturday service is listed later than weekdays.
cards.short_summary: Chinese takeout in Galloway with 10:30 PM Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Hoon King’s official site lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11 AM–10:30 PM and identifies its Galloway address.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday hours through 10:30 PM; Monday–Thursday are listed through 9:30 PM.

cards.title: Harbor Diner
cards.subtitle: 613 White Horse Pike, Egg Harbor City
cards.notes: Make this a Friday or Saturday option when planning a later meal; the diner’s contact page posts a 10 PM close.
cards.short_summary: A nearby diner with 10 PM Friday and Saturday availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Harbor Diner’s official contact page lists Friday and Saturday hours of 7 AM–10 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday and Saturday hours through 10 PM; Sunday–Thursday close at 9 PM.

cards.title: King Phoenix
cards.subtitle: 103 Washington Ave, Egg Harbor City
cards.notes: Use the online ordering page to confirm the day; Friday and Saturday are posted until 10 PM for pickup planning.
cards.short_summary: Egg Harbor City Chinese restaurant open until 10 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: King Phoenix’s official site lists Friday and Saturday business hours of 11 AM–10 PM at 103 Washington Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday hours through 10 PM; Tuesday–Thursday and Sunday close at 9:30 PM.

cards.title: Aroma Indian Cuisine
cards.subtitle: 224 E White Horse Pike, Galloway
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s own schedule before leaving; dinner service is posted through 9:30 PM every day of the week.
cards.short_summary: Galloway Indian cuisine with evening service listed through 9:30 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Aroma Indian Cuisine’s official site lists its Galloway dinner hours as ending at 9:30 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists dinner service through 9:30 PM daily, following an afternoon break on most days.

cards.title: The Madison Room
cards.subtitle: 324 S Pitney Rd, Galloway
cards.notes: For a Friday or Saturday evening meal, use the posted takeout or dining-room schedule and confirm service before departure.
cards.short_summary: A Galloway dining room with Friday and Saturday service through 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: The Madison Room’s official page lists dining-room and takeout hours through 10 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday and Saturday dining-room and takeout hours of 11 AM–10 PM.

cards.title: Main Dining Room at Seaview
cards.subtitle: 401 S New York Rd, Galloway
cards.notes: Plan around the hotel’s posted dinner hours, especially Friday and Saturday, and confirm seating or reservation requirements directly.
cards.short_summary: A Galloway hotel dining room posted until 10 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Seaview’s official dining page lists Main Dining Room hours through 10 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hotel page lists Friday and Saturday hours through 10 PM; other listed days end at 9 PM.

cards.title: The Smithville Inn
cards.subtitle: 1 N New York Rd, Galloway
cards.notes: Use the inn’s official site to check the active dinner schedule; its visitor information identifies the historic Smithville location.
cards.short_summary: Historic Smithville dining with later Friday and Saturday evening hours publicly listed.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smithville Inn’s official website identifies the restaurant at Historic Smithville; its published dining information lists Friday and Saturday service through 9:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: Published dining information lists Friday and Saturday hours through 9:30 PM; confirm the current schedule directly before visiting.

cards.title: Jasmine Desi Asian Grill
cards.subtitle: 310 E White Horse Pike, Galloway
cards.notes: Reserve or verify directly before an evening visit; the restaurant’s published schedule extends Friday and Saturday service to 10 PM.
cards.short_summary: Galloway Indian, Thai, and Chinese dining listed until 10 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Jasmine Desi Asian Grill’s official website identifies the Galloway restaurant; its published hours list Friday and Saturday service until 10 PM.
cards.access_notes: Published hours list Friday and Saturday service through 10 PM; Monday–Thursday and Sunday are listed through 9:30 PM.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented Galloway-campus places for studying, cultural programming, recreation, and low-key time between classes.

cards.title: WGSC Lounge
cards.subtitle: F-103, Galloway campus
cards.notes: Bring a reading or a small group-study task; round tables, couches, and beanbags make this a practical between-class stop.
cards.short_summary: An all-welcome lounge with seating and tables for individual downtime or group study.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton identifies the WGSC Lounge in F-103 as an all-welcome space with round tables for group study, couches, and beanbag chairs.
cards.source_title: The Lounge | Women's, Gender & Sexuality Center
cards.access_notes: Official hours listed as Monday-Friday, 10 a.m.-4:45 p.m.; closed weekends.

cards.title: Northeast Campus Forest Interpretive Trail
cards.subtitle: Northeast campus forest, Galloway campus
cards.notes: Take the short marked route when you want an outdoor reset, and use the four interpretive stops to focus your walk.
cards.short_summary: A sub-0.2-mile interpretive route with four stops about forest resilience and biodiversity.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton says this trail in the northeast campus forest has four stops and is under 0.2 miles one way.
cards.access_notes: Use established trail access and follow posted guidance.

cards.title: Stockton University Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: L-Wing, beside the Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition page before heading over, then use the first- and second-floor galleries for a focused art break.
cards.short_summary: Campus gallery space presenting contemporary and historical exhibitions plus related programming.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art Gallery is in L-Wing beside the Performing Arts Center and offers contemporary and historical exhibitions and programming.
cards.access_notes: Gallery access and exhibition schedules vary; check the official page before visiting.

cards.title: Stockton Performing Arts Center Theatre
cards.subtitle: Galloway campus
cards.notes: Look at the performance calendar and plan an evening around a ticketed or campus event rather than treating the theatre as drop-in space.
cards.short_summary: A 550-seat theatre used for regional, national, and international cultural programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton states that its Performing Arts Center has presented cultural programming since 1976 and seats 550 people.
cards.source_title: Galloway Venues | Stockton University Event Services
cards.access_notes: Attend during scheduled performances or events; entry requirements vary by program.

cards.title: Campus Center Theatre
cards.subtitle: Campus Center, Galloway campus
cards.notes: Watch campus calendars for films, talks, and performances, then arrive with time to find the pre-function gallery outside the room.
cards.short_summary: A 254-seat Campus Center theatre with stage, adjustable lighting, and a nearby pre-function gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton lists the Campus Center Theatre as a 254-seat venue with a performance stage, adjustable lighting, and pre-function gallery space.
cards.source_title: Galloway Venues | Stockton University Event Services
cards.access_notes: Use during scheduled programs or reservations; access is event-dependent.

cards.title: The Lodge at Lakeside
cards.subtitle: Galloway campus lakeside area
cards.notes: Use the nearby lake and Oasis picnic area as a meeting point before a program, and check the event listing for room access.
cards.short_summary: A lakeside campus venue with a stage and adjacent outdoor picnic area.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton lists The Lodge at Lakeside as a venue with a performance stage and nearby lake and Oasis picnic area.
cards.source_title: Galloway Venues | Stockton University Event Services
cards.access_notes: Indoor space may be reserved for events; use the area according to posted access rules.

cards.title: I-Wing Gymnasium
cards.subtitle: I-Wing, Galloway campus
cards.notes: Confirm recreation or event availability before going, then use the named gym as an easy indoor landmark on the academic spine.
cards.short_summary: An approximately 11,727-square-foot gymnasium in I-Wing.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton identifies the I-Wing Gymnasium as an athletic facility of approximately 11,727 square feet.
cards.source_title: Galloway Venues | Stockton University Event Services
cards.access_notes: Facility use can be scheduled or restricted; verify availability with campus recreation or event staff.

cards.title: Sports Center
cards.subtitle: Galloway campus
cards.notes: Check the athletics or recreation schedule before visiting; its large indoor footprint makes it a clear destination for organized activity.
cards.short_summary: A roughly 39,749-square-foot indoor athletic facility with flexible event configurations.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton describes the Sports Center as an approximately 39,749-square-foot athletic facility with three bleacher sections.
cards.source_title: Galloway Venues | Stockton University Event Services
cards.access_notes: Use depends on recreation, athletics, and event scheduling.

cards.title: Campus Center Event Room
cards.subtitle: Campus Center, Galloway campus
cards.notes: Use the Campus Center calendar to spot lectures or organization events here, and arrive early when a room setup may change the entrance flow.
cards.short_summary: A flexible Campus Center multipurpose venue with presentation equipment and a portable stage riser.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton lists the Campus Center Event Room as a multipurpose venue with built-in presentation equipment and a portable stage riser.
cards.source_title: Galloway Venues | Stockton University Event Services
cards.access_notes: Access is tied to scheduled events and reservations.

cards.title: Veterans Park
cards.subtitle: Through the doors to the right of G-Wing, Galloway campus
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate the G-Wing doors, then make this named outdoor stop part of a walk between academic-spine classes.
cards.short_summary: A named campus-map destination accessed through doors beside G-Wing.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton's Galloway campus map identifies Veterans Park and locates it through doors to the right of G-Wing.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is subject to campus conditions and posted notices.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-purchase ways to spend time together at Stockton’s Galloway campus, using spaces and equipment the university explicitly identifies as free.

cards.title: Play billiards in the Game Room
cards.subtitle: Campus Center Coffee House & Game Room
cards.notes: Bring a Stockton ID, borrow the billiards equipment, and set up a low-key game between classes. Confirm the desk’s current availability when you arrive.
cards.short_summary: A free, ID-based billiards option in the Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton states that Game Room recreational games, including billiards, are free for the Stockton community; a Stockton ID is required to borrow equipment.
cards.access_notes: For the Stockton University community; bring a Stockton ID to borrow games and equipment. The university lists Game Room hours as daily during the academic semester, subject to breaks and summer closure.

cards.entity_name: Campus Center Game Room Ping Pong
cards.title: Rally at the ping-pong table
cards.subtitle: Campus Center Coffee House & Game Room
cards.notes: Use your Stockton ID to check out ping-pong equipment, then make it a quick doubles match or a relaxed rally while everyone is on campus.
cards.short_summary: Free ping pong with university-provided equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton lists ping pong among the recreational games the Campus Center Game Room offers the Stockton community to play for free.
cards.access_notes: For the Stockton University community; a Stockton ID is required to borrow Game Room equipment. Check current conditions during breaks or summer.

cards.title: Start a foosball match
cards.subtitle: Campus Center Coffee House & Game Room
cards.notes: Gather two or four players, borrow the equipment with a Stockton ID, and play a short round before heading to your next campus stop.
cards.short_summary: A free foosball game in the Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton lists foosball among the recreational games the Campus Center Game Room offers the Stockton community to play for free.
cards.access_notes: For the Stockton University community; a Stockton ID is required to borrow Game Room equipment. Game Room hours vary outside the academic semester.

cards.entity_name: Campus Center Game Room Board Games
cards.title: Choose a board game together
cards.subtitle: Campus Center Coffee House & Game Room
cards.notes: Use a Stockton ID to borrow a board game and claim a nearby table for a slower hang. Return borrowed equipment through the Game Room process.
cards.short_summary: Free board-game borrowing for the Stockton community.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton lists board games among the recreational games the Campus Center Game Room offers the Stockton community to play for free.
cards.access_notes: For the Stockton University community; a Stockton ID is required to borrow games and equipment. Availability can change during breaks and summer.

cards.entity_name: Give a Book, Take a Book Lounge
cards.title: Swap a book at the Coffee House
cards.subtitle: Campus Center Coffee House
cards.notes: Bring along a finished read if you have one, browse the shelf together, and trade for something new. The university invites everyone to leave a book and take one.
cards.short_summary: A casual book exchange inside the Campus Center Coffee House.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton’s Coffee House page identifies the Give a Book, Take a Book Lounge and says all are welcome to leave a book on the shelf and take a new one.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Campus Center Coffee House. Bring a book only if you want to leave one; the university’s stated exchange invitation is open to all.

cards.title: See the Art Gallery exhibitions
cards.subtitle: L-wing, beside the Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Meet in L-wing and take in the current exhibition at your own pace. Check the gallery page before going, since exhibitions and public hours change seasonally.
cards.short_summary: Free public access to changing exhibitions on the Galloway campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton University Art Gallery states that it is free and open to the public during exhibitions and is located in L-wing beside the Performing Arts Center.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public during exhibitions. The gallery lists seasonal hours and notes that weekday visitor parking requirements may apply before 3 p.m.

cards.title: Recharge and catch up in Overlook Lounge
cards.subtitle: Campus Center, upper level
cards.notes: Bring devices and use the charging station while your group works or talks in the lounge. The space also has seating, tables, TV viewing, and monitor-equipped worktables.
cards.short_summary: A free device-charging stop with lounge seating and collaborative work space.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton says its Campus Center charging stations are available free of charge and identifies one in Overlook Lounge, which also has lounge furniture and worktables.
cards.access_notes: Located on the Campus Center’s second level. The charging station is free of charge; use the lounge respectfully around other students’ study and group-work needs.

cards.title: Plug in at the Coffee House
cards.subtitle: Campus Center, main level
cards.notes: Use the free Coffee House charging station as a meet-up point, then settle into the shared hangout area to talk, read, or plan the rest of your day.
cards.short_summary: A no-purchase charging stop in Stockton’s central Coffee House.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton says Campus Center charging stations are available free of charge and lists one in the Coffeehouse on the main level.
cards.access_notes: Main-level Campus Center Coffee House. The charging station is free of charge; buying food or drinks is not required to use that amenity.

cards.title: Read or study in Bjork Library
cards.subtitle: E-wing Library, Galloway campus
cards.notes: Choose an open table, carrel, chair, or lounge seat and make it a quiet shared work session. Keep group conversation to the Learning Commons and respect designated quiet areas.
cards.short_summary: Open library spaces for reading, viewing materials, and study.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton’s library-space procedure designates open library spaces as public access areas and makes them available to library users for study, reading, and use of materials.
cards.access_notes: Open spaces, including tables, chairs, carrels, and lounge furniture, are public access areas on a first-come basis. Group study rooms are restricted to Stockton students and employees with reservations.

cards.entity_name: Campus Center Information & Operations Desk Push Carts
cards.title: Borrow a push cart for a group haul
cards.subtitle: Campus Center Grand Hall, main level
cards.notes: If your group is moving supplies or projects across campus, ask at the Information & Operations Desk for a push cart and return it after the trip.
cards.short_summary: Free push-cart borrowing from the Campus Center desk.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton states that push carts are available from the Campus Center Information & Operations Desk and that cart rentals are free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Request a push cart from the Information & Operations Desk during its regular business hours. Coordinate with desk staff on checkout and return.

cards.title: Toy Market for puzzles and games
cards.subtitle: Historic Smithville & Village Greene corridor, off N New York Road
cards.notes: Find Shoppe 5 on the Historic Smithville corridor and browse the listed puzzles, games, books, science kits, and classic toys.
cards.short_summary: A named village shop for hands-on games, puzzles, books, and science kits.
cards.evidence_claim: Toy Market lists toys, puzzles, games, books, science kits, and other creative-play items at Shoppe 5.
cards.access_notes: Shoppe 5 in Historic Smithville & the Village Greene; confirm current shop hours before traveling.

cards.title: Candle Shoppe for scent browsing

cards.notes: Stop at Shoppe 2 to compare the listed scented candle formats and browse candle holders, lamps, and other accessories.

cards.title: Village Sweet Shoppe for candy

cards.short_summary: A named Historic Smithville candy shop with several classic confection categories.
cards.evidence_claim: The Historic Smithville brochure identifies Village Sweet Shoppe at Shoppe 35 and lists Jelly Bellys, stick candy, taffy, and fudge.
cards.source_title: Historic Smithville Brochure and Towne Map
cards.access_notes: Shoppe 35 in Historic Smithville & the Village Greene; confirm current shop hours before traveling.

cards.title: Smithville Bakery for baked goods

cards.notes: Use Shoppe 20 as a bakery stop and look for the brochure-listed baked-on-premises pastries, rolls, cookies, and breads.
cards.short_summary: A named village bakery whose official brochure lists baked-on-premises goods.
cards.evidence_claim: The Historic Smithville brochure identifies Smithville Bakery at Shoppe 20 and lists pastries, rolls, cookies, and breads baked on premises.
cards.source_title: Historic Smithville Brochure and Towne Map
cards.access_notes: Shoppe 20 in Historic Smithville & the Village Greene; confirm current bakery hours before traveling.

cards.title: Costello's Pizzeria for a pizza meal

cards.notes: Head to Shoppe 77 when you want an eat-in or takeout pizza option within the Historic Smithville and Village Greene corridor.
cards.short_summary: A named village pizzeria that offers both eat-in and takeout service.
cards.evidence_claim: The Historic Smithville brochure identifies Costello's Pizzeria at Shoppe 77 and states that it offers eat-in or takeout.
cards.source_title: Historic Smithville Brochure and Towne Map
cards.access_notes: Shoppe 77 in Historic Smithville & the Village Greene; confirm current restaurant hours before traveling.

cards.title: Scoop's Place for an ice-cream sundae

cards.notes: Find Shoppe 78 for a dessert stop; the official brochure describes specialty ice-cream flavors for building a sundae by Lake Meone.
cards.short_summary: A named boardwalk-side ice-cream shop overlooking Lake Meone.
cards.evidence_claim: The Historic Smithville brochure identifies Scoop's Place at Shoppe 78 and describes specialty ice-cream flavors and sundaes overlooking Lake Meone.
cards.source_title: Historic Smithville Brochure and Towne Map
cards.access_notes: Shoppe 78 in Historic Smithville & the Village Greene; confirm current shop hours before traveling.

cards.evidence_claim: Lakeside Grill states that it serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner and overlooks Lake Meone.
cards.access_notes: Shoppe 74 in Historic Smithville & the Village Greene; confirm current restaurant hours before traveling.

cards.short_summary: A named village cafe with coffee, espresso, hot chocolate, and smoothies on its official listing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Historic Smithville brochure identifies The Colonial Coffee Cafe at Shoppe 96 and lists coffee, cappuccino, espresso, hot chocolate, and smoothies.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Stockton customs spanning welcome-week rituals, University Weekend, and commencement.

cards.title: Join hands for the alma mater
cards.subtitle: Stockton Commencement tradition
cards.notes: At commencement, join the raised-arm, linked-hand singing of “Ospreys on Parade” with graduates, faculty, and staff.
cards.short_summary: Stockton’s alma mater is sung as a collective linked-hands ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton describes commencement as a tradition where students, faculty and staff raise joined hands while singing the alma mater, “Ospreys on Parade.”
cards.access_notes: Occurs during Stockton commencement ceremonies.

cards.title: Watch Golden Ospreys lead the procession
cards.subtitle: 50th-reunion alumni at Commencement
cards.notes: Look for the incoming Golden Osprey class leading commencement, connecting 50-year alumni with the newest graduates.
cards.short_summary: Alumni celebrating 50 years since graduation lead Stockton’s commencement procession.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton says each incoming Golden Osprey class leads Commencement annually as a 50th-anniversary tradition.
cards.access_notes: Golden Osprey participation is for alumni at their 50th graduation anniversary.

cards.title: Circle University Weekend on the calendar
cards.subtitle: Stockton’s campus-and-alumni celebration
cards.notes: Plan around the University Weekend program, which brings students, alumni, families, and staff together for campus events.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Stockton celebration that gathers the wider Osprey community.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton characterizes University Weekend as a Stockton tradition and describes students, alumni, families and staff celebrating together.
cards.access_notes: See the official University Weekend page for the current program and dates.

cards.title: Make a float before the weekend
cards.subtitle: University Weekend tradition
cards.notes: Join the scheduled Float Decorating Party when it appears on the University Weekend calendar; it is a designated shirt-pickup event.
cards.short_summary: A pre-weekend float-making gathering built into Stockton’s University Weekend programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton lists a Float Decorating Party among University Weekend events and as a location for eligible students to pick up a University Weekend T-shirt.
cards.access_notes: Check the official University Weekend schedule; programming changes by year.

cards.title: Walk the University Weekend Street Fair
cards.subtitle: University Weekend tradition
cards.notes: Visit the Street Fair during University Weekend to see campus organizations alongside invited local artisans, nonprofits, and businesses.
cards.short_summary: A Stockton weekend fair combining campus groups and community vendors.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton’s University Weekend page identifies the Street Fair as a current event and says local artisans, nonprofits and businesses are invited.
cards.access_notes: Vendor goods may require purchase; event details vary by year.

cards.title: Add Coast Day to University Weekend
cards.subtitle: University Weekend coastal program
cards.notes: Check the University Weekend lineup for Coast Day, a named Stockton event associated with the annual weekend program.
cards.short_summary: A coastal-themed event that appears in Stockton’s University Weekend tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton lists Coast Day as one of the events associated with University Weekend.
cards.source_title: 10 Things Every Osprey Needs to Know
cards.access_notes: Consult the official University Weekend schedule for the current Coast Day details.

cards.title: Find the Fred Fest activities
cards.subtitle: University Weekend and Lake Fred programming
cards.notes: Look for Fred Fest in the University Weekend schedule; Stockton’s Student Development page documents students canoeing at the event.
cards.short_summary: A Lake Fred-centered Stockton event with documented canoeing activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton identifies Fred Fest as a University Weekend event and its Student Development page captions students canoeing at Fred Fest.
cards.access_notes: Check the current event schedule and any activity requirements before attending.

cards.title: Take the two-lap Spirit Walk
cards.subtitle: New-Osprey Welcome Week ritual
cards.notes: During Welcome Week Spirit Walk programming, join the two track laps: one for contributing your gifts and one for finishing your degree.
cards.short_summary: Two laps give new students a specific pair of commitments to carry into college.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton reported that new students walked two laps in the Spirit Walk, symbolizing commitments to contribute their talents and complete their degrees.
cards.access_notes: Part of Welcome Week programming; availability and format can change annually.

cards.title: Skim the Mighty Burner touchstone
cards.subtitle: Spirit Walk at Stockton’s track
cards.notes: On the Welcome Week Spirit Walk, follow the route to the track and skim a hand across the G. Larry James touchstone.
cards.short_summary: A welcome-week touchstone gesture honoring Stockton’s longtime athletics leader.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton documented Spirit Walk participants skimming a hand on the G. Larry James touchstone, honoring the Olympic medalist and longtime Stockton athletics leader.
cards.source_title: Picture Stockton...Welcoming New Ospreys with Open Wings
cards.access_notes: The gesture was documented during Welcome Week’s Spirit Walk.

cards.entity_name: Kappa Sigma Annual Polar Bear Plunge
cards.title: Support the Polar Bear Plunge cause
cards.subtitle: Xi-Rho Chapter service tradition
cards.notes: If participating, follow the organizers’ current safety and registration directions for Stockton’s annual charity plunge in Atlantic City.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Kappa Sigma Xi-Rho charitable plunge connected to Stockton.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton reports that Kappa Sigma’s Xi-Rho Chapter hosts an annual Polar Bear Plunge for charity and calls it one of Stockton’s largest fraternity or sorority service events.
cards.access_notes: Participation requires following the organizer’s current safety guidance; spectating may be an alternative.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Stockton University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key first-weekend sequence built around Stockton’s Galloway campus spaces, a lake walk, campus activities, and event planning.

cards.title: Start at the Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Galloway campus
cards.notes: Use the Campus Center as your orientation point: find the Information & Operations Desk, scan the building directory, and choose one next stop.
